newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus accepts wheat, barley tenders.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus accepts wheat, barley tenders.

text.p: The Cyprus Grain Commission on Friday accepted Tradigrain S.A. Geneva's tender for 25,000 tonnes of barley at $140.87 per tonne and Toepfer's tender for 12,000 tonnes of European wheat at 158.73 per tonne.
Both prices include cost and freight out of Limassol, a statement from the grain commission said.
The barley shipment is scheduled in February and the wheat shipment in the second fortnight of March.
